title: [Salty's Services, Displays]
description: Stone and wood-carved creatures, figures, and objects of varying size and shape clutter this section of the warehouse, placed in a disorderly manner such that there is no clear path through them from one end of the area to the other.  The carved figures represent a collection ranging from sea creatures to noteworthy Kraken's Fall sights and figures.  Above, several iron braziers cast a significant light across the area, ensuring the room is bright enough to observe the multitude of decorative options.
